# Healthline

> Healthline is a trusted medical information platform providing comprehensive health advice, disease management guides, and wellness resources across major health conditions and lifestyle topics.

Healthline offers evidence-based medical information and patient education covering chronic diseases, mental health, cancer care, and general wellness. The platform serves as a comprehensive health reference with specialized resource centers for major conditions and symptom management guidance.

## Key Topics

- Chronic Disease Management
- Cancer Care
- Mental Health & Well-Being
- Neurological Conditions
- Cardiovascular Health
- Digestive Health
- Autoimmune Diseases
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Sleep Health
- Weight Management
- Disease Information
- Symptom Management
- Medical Reference
- Wellness Resources
- Patient Education

## Core Health Hubs

- [Healthline: Medical information and health advice you can trust.](https://www.healthline.com): Healthline homepage offering medical information, health advice, and wellness resources.
- [Directory Health Topics](https://www.healthline.com/directory/topics): Directory of health topics covering medical conditions, wellness, and disease information.
- [Healthline Mental Well-Being](https://www.healthline.com/mental-health): Mental health hub covering conditions, therapy, mindfulness, and well-being topics.
- [Heart Health](https://www.healthline.com/heart-health): Heart health hub with cardiovascular disease management and wellness resources.
- [Digestive Health | Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/digestive-health): Digestive health hub covering conditions, nutrition, and wellness guidance.

## Cancer & Oncology

- [Cancer Care | Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/cancer-care): Cancer care hub providing disease information, medical guides, and patient education.
- [Breast Cancer Resource Center: Types, Stages, Treatments](https://www.healthline.com/breast-cancer): Comprehensive breast cancer guide covering symptoms, treatments, research, and support.

## Chronic & Neurological Conditions

- [Chronic Kidney Disease](https://www.healthline.com/ckd): Chronic kidney disease hub with medical information and patient management guides.
- [Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)](https://www.healthline.com/copd): COPD overview with health tips, tools, and respiratory disease information.
- [Type 2 Diabetes](https://www.healthline.com/type-2-diabetes): Type 2 diabetes hub with disease overview and chronic disease management resources.
- [Caregiving for Alzheimer's Disease | Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/alzheimers-disease): Alzheimer's caregiving guide with disease management and elderly care resources.
- [Parkinson's Disease](https://www.healthline.com/parkinsons-disease): Parkinson's disease overview with neurological condition information and support tools.
- [Multiple Sclerosis Resource Center: Treatments, Managing Symptoms](https://www.healthline.com/multiple-sclerosis): MS resource center covering treatments, symptom management, and patient guidance.

## Autoimmune & Inflammatory Conditions

- [Rheumatoid Arthritis Resource Center: Symptoms, Treatments, Tips](https://www.healthline.com/rheumatoid-arthritis): Rheumatoid arthritis resource center covering symptoms, treatments, and lifestyle tips.
- [Psoriasis](https://www.healthline.com/psoriasis): Psoriasis hub with skin condition management, dermatology info, and wellness guides.
- [Migraine Resource Center: Diagnosis, Treatments, Alternative Therapies](https://www.healthline.com/migraine): Migraine resource center with diagnosis, treatments, and alternative therapy information.

## Women's Health & Wellness

- [Menopause](https://www.healthline.com/menopause): Menopause guide supporting women's health through symptom management and wellness.

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Healthline Sleep](https://www.healthline.com/sleep): Sleep health hub with science-backed content on sleep science and wellness products.
- [Weight Management | Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/weight-management): Weight management hub covering nutrition, fitness, and healthy lifestyle guidance.
- [Eye Health | Healthline](https://www.healthline.com/eye-health): Eye health and vision care hub with medical information and patient education.
